chunks: On the night of the nineteenth of the month of Ramadan is the decreeing, on the night of the twenty-first is the judgment, and on the night of the twenty-third is the confirmation of what will occur in the year until its like. And for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is to do whatever He wills in His creation.

key_terms.إِبْرَامُ: the final confirmation and ratification of what is to occur
key_terms.التَّقْدِيرُ: the measuring out or decreeing of affairs
key_terms.السَّنَةِ: the year, referring to the period until the next corresponding time
key_terms.الْقَضَاءُ: the deciding or ordaining of matters
key_terms.خَلْقِهِ: His creation, over which Allah exercises His will
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ إِحْدَى وَ عِشْرِينَ: the twenty-first night, identified as a night of judgment
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ: the nineteenth night, identified as a night of decreeing
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ ثَلَاثٍ وَ عِشْرِينَ: the twenty-third night, identified as a night of confirmation

ai.seo_question: What happens on the 19th, 21st, and 23rd nights of Ramadan according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes distinct stages associated with the nights of the nineteenth, twenty-first, and twenty-third of Ramadan in relation to divine decree. It also affirms that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, retains complete authority to act as He wills in His creation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2020 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"On the night of the 19th of Month of Ramadan is the decree, on the night of the 21st is the judgment, and on the night of the 23rd is the confirmation of what will occur in the year until its similar time. And Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has the authority to do as He wills with His creation."
